prerequisite: The independent seed6531000 both-seat complete-game gate passed against the same frozen full replanned teacher. No controller, checkpoint, search parameter or game rule changes are permitted.
smoke: Use two non-gate Classic Generic procedural_v2 maps seed6531900, both source seats, to verify exact observation/legal-action equality in separate forks, legal actions, deterministic source roll-in and query accounting. Exclude these states from all latency claims.
arena: Fresh16 independent Classic Generic procedural_v2 11x9 two-player maps seed6532000, both source seats, action limit2400. Roll in routed-v6 direct against the full replanned three-turn native opponent. Sample every source decision in its first12 completed turns per game, or until that game ends. Never use candidate or teacher hypothetical actions to advance the roll-in.
matched_selection: At each sampled live source-decision state, fork exact BatchObservations and legal-action order for isolated native searches. On the SAME observation measure frozen routed-v6 argmax, frozen selective controller (both source and rejected Markov student inference plus native replanned search only on disagreement), and full native replanned search. Rotate measurement order by seed, seat and action index. Fork construction and equality checks are outside timed selection. Include all sampled actions without discarding warmup. Aggregate per-action and source-turn CPU process time and wall time, median and p95, separately by root seat and overall. These source-visited states are not candidate on-policy latency.
frozen_inputs: routed-v6 SHA68549a5af87e4d2d065a164e39bc515c2c1d48276f437494d757e25c3ef28867; rejected Markov student SHA1d6e6530bb2f16d273910fdeb4b2de491d2e115017468eb3f31d3aea43f64fe4; native root beam256/top8 distinct turns/opponent beam64/followup beam32 with replan_each_action=true. No terminal oracle.
gate: Require exact fork observation/legal-action equality and legal selections on every sample, zero action-limit-censored roll-ins before the sampling cap, a selective query fraction at most50%, selective median process-CPU milliseconds per matched action strictly below full native teacher, selective p95 process-CPU milliseconds per matched action at most full native teacher p95, and absolute selective p95 below250ms. Report candidate/source/teacher action and source-turn distributions, CPU and wall, by seat and overall even on failure. A failed gate rejects selective playable promotion; do not tune thresholds or revisit inspected seed6532000.
qualification: This measures frozen selector compute on identical source-visited states, not candidate complete-game runtime, browser WASM latency, strength, Elo or standalone neural distillation. Browser latency and new Online Default/Classic Slay game profiles remain separate gates if this passes.
resources: Only SSH server fedora-toolbox scratch, one pinned CPU15 nice19 with Rayon/BLAS threads capped at1, bounded run and tiny report. No local heavy compute, GPU, concurrent heavy job, rated/browser agent or Site changes.
